Description:
Let employees use the platform under a random pseudo-ID that can never be traced back to their corporate identity, and let therapists and admins sign in securely.

Lab 1 source: FR-001, FR-006, NFR-001, UC-01

Let employees find a licensed therapist by speciality and book, reschedule or cancel a session, while therapists manage their own availability.

Lab 1 source: FR-002, NFR-002, UC-03, UC-05, UC-07

Run telehealth counseling sessions and keep employees informed about their appointments through confirmations and reminders.

Lab 1 source: UC-04, UC-08, UC-03 (step 8 / 8a)

Record how an employee feels before and after each session against their pseudo-ID only, so they can follow their own progress without ever being identified.

Lab 1 source: FR-003, FR-004, FR-005

Give HR an aggregated, non-identifying view of the pilot's effect on the workforce and a place to share wellness resources.

Lab 1 source: FR-004, UC-06

Summary: Story 1.1: Anonymous pseudo-ID on sign in
Description:
As an employee, I want the platform to give me a random pseudo-ID when I enter it, so that I can use counseling services without my corporate email or employee ID being revealed.

Acceptance criteria: A new random ID is generated in a few milliseconds; no corporate identifier is stored with it.

Lab 1 source: FR-001, FR-006, NFR-001

Summary: Story 1.2: Continue with my existing pseudo-ID
Description:
As an employee, I want to choose to continue with a pseudo-ID I used before, so that my session history and progress stay together.

Acceptance criteria: Entering a previously issued ID restores its history; nothing else links it to the employee.

Lab 1 source: NFR-001, FR-003

As a therapist, I want to see only the client's pseudo-ID on my dashboard, so that the employee's identity stays confidential.

Acceptance criteria: Therapist dashboard and appointment details show the pseudo-ID and no other identifier.

Lab 1 source: FR-001

As a therapist or HR admin, I want to log in with my own account, so that only authorised staff can manage availability and the programme.

Acceptance criteria: Login required for therapist and admin pages; wrong credentials are rejected.

Lab 1 source: UC-01

As an employee, I want to browse licensed therapists filtered by speciality and availability, so that I can pick someone suited to what I need.

Acceptance criteria: List shows speciality, availability and contact options; filter by speciality works.

Lab 1 source: FR-002, UC-03 (step 2)

As an employee, I want to choose a therapist, date, time and session mode and confirm the booking, so that I have a confirmed counseling appointment.

Acceptance criteria: Booking is recorded, the slot is removed from availability and booking details are shown.

Lab 1 source: UC-03 (steps 1-9)

Summary: Story 2.3: Handle a slot that was just taken
Description:
As an employee, I want to be told when my chosen slot is no longer free and see the latest slots, so that I can quickly pick another time instead of getting an error.

Acceptance criteria: If the slot is taken during booking, a message is shown and the slot list refreshes.

Lab 1 source: UC-03 (alternate flow 3a)

As a therapist, I want to add, change and remove my available time slots, so that employees can only book times when I can actually take sessions.

Acceptance criteria: Changes appear in the booking list immediately; booked slots cannot be deleted.

Lab 1 source: UC-05

Summary: Story 2.5: Reschedule or cancel an appointment
Description:
As an employee, I want to reschedule or cancel a booked appointment, so that I can fit counseling around my work.

Acceptance criteria: Cancelled slots return to the therapist's availability; both sides see the change.

Lab 1 source: UC-07

Summary: Story 2.6: Show times in my own time zone
Description:
As an employee in a global office, I want appointment times to be shown in my local time zone, so that I don't miss sessions because of time zone differences.

Acceptance criteria: Times are stored in UTC and shown in the viewer's time zone for employee and therapist.

Lab 1 source: NFR-002

As an employee, I want to join my counseling session online from the platform, so that I can attend from wherever I am.

Acceptance criteria: Join link is active at the booked time for both participants via the telemedicine service.

Lab 1 source: UC-04

As an employee, I want to get a confirmation when my booking is made, so that I know the appointment went through and have the details.

Acceptance criteria: Confirmation is sent through the notification service right after booking.

Lab 1 source: UC-08, UC-03 (step 8)

As an employee, I want my booking to stay active and be shown in the portal if the notification fails, so that a notification outage never loses my appointment.

Acceptance criteria: Failed notifications are marked for retry; booking details stay visible in the portal.

Lab 1 source: UC-03 (alternate flow 8a)

As an employee, I want a reminder before my session starts, so that I don't forget my appointment.

Acceptance criteria: Reminder is sent a set time before the session.

Lab 1 source: UC-08

As an employee, I want to rate how I feel before and after each session, so that the effect of each session can be measured.

Acceptance criteria: Check-in is stored against the pseudo-ID only and is linked to the session.

Lab 1 source: FR-004

Summary: Story 4.2: View my progress over time
Description:
As an employee, I want to see my check-in results over time under my pseudo-ID, so that I can follow my own long-term wellbeing.

Acceptance criteria: Progress chart shows only data for the current pseudo-ID.

Lab 1 source: FR-003

As an employee, I want every wellbeing question to be optional, so that I am never pressured into sharing more than I want to.

Acceptance criteria: Every question can be skipped; skipping never blocks booking or sessions.

Lab 1 source: FR-005

As an HR / wellness admin, I want to see aggregated pilot results and overall workforce wellbeing trends, so that I can judge the programme without singling out any employee.

Acceptance criteria: Only aggregates are shown, and only for groups above a minimum size.

Lab 1 source: FR-004

As an HR / wellness admin, I want to publish articles and self-help resources, so that employees have support between sessions.

Acceptance criteria: Admin can add, edit and remove resources.

Lab 1 source: UC-06

As an employee, I want to browse wellness resources anonymously, so that I can get help without booking a session.

Acceptance criteria: Resources can be read without any identifying information being recorded.

Lab 1 source: UC-06
